items.text: [p align="start"]October 17, 2026

[p align="start"]• Placement preview: When carrying a box, see where products will go on shelves, clothing rails and produce stands, and where boxes will fit on storage racks. The crosshair turns green when placement is possible and red when the spot is full, reserved or unsuitable.

[p align="start"]• Graphics quality presets: Choose Low, Medium or High. On first launch, the game selects a preset based on your graphics card’s memory. Texture memory stays well below the preset’s target to help reduce stuttering. Your chosen quality level is remembered across updates.

[p align="start"]• Max Staff Per Shelf now keeps your chosen value instead of reverting to 2. You can change it from the main menu. This setting is shared across all save slots; when you first load an older save, its value becomes the setting.
[p align="start"]• Changing graphics quality no longer resets V-Sync or your frame-rate limit. Unapplied graphics changes are discarded when you close the settings menu.
[p align="start"]• Improved Steam Cloud saving and quitting. Cloud saves are now more reliable, and saving issues are less likely to prevent the game from closing.

[p align="start"]• An unreadable save slot no longer prevents you from starting a new game. New Game offers an empty slot and leaves the unreadable save untouched. Save problems in the main menu are now shown on screen.

[p align="start"]• Fixed saves that incorrectly showed “No Fridge” or “No Freezer” and prevented refrigerated or frozen products from being sold, even when the store already had the required appliances.

[p align="start"]• Staff no longer repeatedly pick up and put down the same empty or spoiled box when a trash bin can’t be reached. Blocked bins are skipped for a while, and boxes that can’t be discarded are taken to outdoor drop spots and spread between them.

[p align="start"]• Staff no longer stack boxes into towers. Boxes are placed on nearby reachable floor space, never on top of other boxes, behind walls or over balcony edges. Unloading a stock cart no longer leaves boxes stuck in shelves or walls.

[p align="start"]• Customers who can’t reach a shelf, checkout or exit no longer wait forever. After about a minute, they give up on that trip, step out of blocked checkout queues so others can move forward, or leave the shop if they get stuck again. Customers interrupted while paying at a self-checkout no longer remain stuck in a paying state. These fixes ensure the day can always end.
[p align="start"]• Fixed crash issues.
• Moving objects no longer causes slowdowns.
[p align="start"]• Fluorescent ceiling lights, escalator rim lights and factory lamps glow again.

[p align="start"]• Refreshed the store’s interior lighting. Lighting was re-baked, the floor and several interior surfaces now use the store’s light probes, the interior walls are brighter and the ceiling is slightly darker. Reflections were updated, and the overall image is a little brighter and more saturated. The store sign now has a glossy blue background with light-colored lettering.
[p align="start"]• Freezer display cabinets and beverage showcases now have a soft glow and a slightly glossier finish.
[p align="start"]• Retuned the highlight on the item you’re looking at and fixed a Halloween pumpkin that always appeared highlighted.

[p align="start"]• Picking up a product no longer flashes a red “more below” arrow beside the carried-items list. The arrow now appears only when you carry more product types than the list can show. Carried item counts are now green instead of red.
[p align="start"]• Folded clothing labels have their white backgrounds back and sit neatly on the fabric. Clothes removed from a rail now show the correct name and icon.
[p align="start"]• Halloween products now have their own names in every language. Books show the titles printed on their covers, and two books have new cover art.
[p align="start"]• Fixed the pet supplies category name in French, German, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Danish, Spanish and Swedish.
[p align="start"]• Loading saves with many fruit and vegetable shelves now involves less repeated work.
[p align="start"]
🎃 Halloween Furniture Is Back!
[p align="start"]Halloween furniture is back for you to decorate your store!
[p align="start"]Give your hypermarket a spooky makeover and get ready for Halloween. 👻🕸️
[p align="start"]• Improved employee box placement to reduce collisions when putting down carried boxes or unloading individual boxes from stock carts.
[p align="start"]• Employees now prioritize pallets containing temperature-sensitive products and prefer suitable cold storage when available.
[p align="start"]• Pallets placed on storage racks now correctly follow the rack’s cooling state.
[p align="start"]• Employees also reconsider storage destinations when cooling conditions change.
[p align="start"]• New deliveries now keep full pallets of the same product together, mixing only leftover quantities.
[p align="start"]• Delivery trucks loaded from older saves retain their previous packing arrangements.
[p align="start"]• Price and discount edits now take effect only when confirmed.
[p align="start"]• Closing the panel with Escape or Back keeps the previous settings.
[p align="start"]• Unconfirmed edits no longer affect customer interest.
[p align="start"]• Improved customer escalator boarding to reduce unnecessary waiting near entrances.
[p align="start"]• The “Order products” objective now completes as soon as a product purchase order is confirmed, without waiting for delivery.
[p align="start"]• Fixed objective completion actions being triggered more than once.
[p align="start"]• Fixed a loading issue that could leave starting a new game stuck at 0%.
[p align="start"]• Corrected issues when returning to the main menu.
[p align="start"]• Fixed unintended audio muting when closing settings from the main menu.
[p align="start"]• Improved recovery of earned store-level achievements when loading a save.
[p align="start"]• Pending achievements are now retried when Steam becomes available.
[p align="start"]Thank you for playing Hypermarket Simulator and for all your feedback! ❤️

items.text: Hello everyone!
[p align="start"]Warehouse Update 2 will be released tonight!
[p align="start"]This is one of our biggest updates so far, introducing a completely new delivery system that changes how you order and receive products.
[p align="start"]What's new?
🚚 Brand-new delivery system
📦 Products are now delivered by truck instead of instantly
🛒 New Orders menu
📦 Choose between box and pallet deliveries
📍 Select your preferred delivery dock
🏬 Store Front (A) and Warehouse (B) delivery docks
📱 New Tablet
🛒 New Stock Carts
🚜 New Forklift
☁️ Steam Cloud Save support
💾 Multiple save slots
🛠️ Bug fixes, performance improvements, and quality-of-life enhancements
✨ And much more!
[p align="start"]Thank you all for your incredible support. We can't wait for you to try the update!
[p align="start"]See you tonight!
To better understand how the new delivery system works, be sure to watch this video:
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/n1xJOTUpJSo"]
Fixes
-Fixed customer checkout product placement delays.
-Fixed font issues affecting aisle signs and store title text.
-Fixed an issue where the Wall-Mounted Kitchen Cabinet could be placed on the floor instead of on walls.
-Fixed escalator carrying behavior where carried objects could lag behind the player while moving between floors.
-Fixed navigation issues causing staff to struggle when moving between the new Warehouse Racks.
-Fixed aisle sign text rendering so custom labels update instantly and display correctly in all supported languages.
-Fixed the color picker so players can select the intended color directly from the main palette without needing additional slider adjustments.
-Fixed an issue where the outdoor store sign font unlock text could display placeholder values such as "XX Fonts" and prevent newly unlocked fonts from appearing correctly.
-Fixed an issue that could cause the day counter to skip after starting a new day.
-Fixed an issue causing the sky to appear unnaturally dark in certain situations.
-Fixed excessive material shine on vehicles parked in the parking lot.
Improvements
-Improved reliability of object placement on escalators by better detecting valid placement surfaces and hiding placement-only helper objects when placement is not possible.
-Improved staff reliability when using escalators.
-Added clearer numbering for Warehouse Racks and shelves.
-Warehouse rack tags and shelf labels now use a numbering system, making storage areas easier to identify, organize, and manage.
-Staff now react faster to newly delivered boxes, reducing delays in warehouse operations.
-Improved save/load handling for Design Panel Managers and Store Title font/material settings.
👉 https://discord.gg/yagvmMCnR7
Increased the size of the Delivery Location Marker checker area so it more accurately shows where delivered boxes can be distributed.
Updated Warehouse Racks so they can now store the largest box sizes as well.
Improved the frosty/snow material on Warehouse Racks for a better visual appearance.
Fixed an issue where display item boxes could stack in one row on Warehouse Racks. Now you can add two row.
Fixed an issue that made AC units difficult to place on Warehouse walls.
Added a secret Computer Teleporter button for the ones who could not locate their in-game computer.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564029/445addaff45d47cedd7015437c3e8d6cb20cb03d.jpg"]
Prices can once again be set from both the computer and racks.

The cone and staff gathering point have been moved from the back of the store to the side of the building near the Warehouse entrance. (This only affects players who had these objects placed behind the store, where the new Warehouse area has now been added)
Improved performance in stores with very large numbers of products.
Optimized staff and customer systems to reduce lag.
Added the new Warehouse area and a New Warehouse Rack.
Added 6 unlockable Warehouse expansions.
Updated the visuals of expansion cards on the computer.
Fixed an issue where players could not properly pass through the Warehouse entrance.
Staff are now smarter when restocking shelves.
Staff will prioritize shelves with the most available space.
Improved decision-making when restocking from the floor or from storage.
Reduced situations where staff could become stuck.
When stocking with loose products, fresher items are now prioritized first.
Increased maximum staff capacity from 31 (24 permanent + 7 daily) to 36 (26 permanent + 10 daily).
Added 4 new shelf types. (Inner and Outer Corner Racks)
Storage racks now correctly keep their frosty cooling-area appearance after briefly turning red while being moved near obstacles.
Display items can now be placed on the floor correctly.
Increased the buildable area in front of the store by approximately 30%.
Objects that cannot be placed no longer get stuck in place; they now continue moving while showing the red invalid-placement state.
Fixed various placement restriction issues and incorrect placement warnings.
Fixed a rail-clothing edge case where quickly picking up an item during the placement animation could leave an unfolded clothing object stuck inside a box.
Attempted a fix for the POS terminal issue where product prices could occasionally fail to display.
Fixed several untranslated texts found on expansion cards.
What's Next?
We're already working on the next update, which will introduce truck deliveries, pallets, and a brand-new stock cart to make warehouse and stock management even more immersive.

[p align="start"]
This update brings plenty of new items to decorate your store and office, helping you prepare for the upcoming Staff Management Update.
We’ve also added a brand-new extra trash bin that you can freely place anywhere, and now all trash bins are fully movable for maximum flexibility.
On top of that, we’ve worked hard on fixing the customer freezing bug, and we believe this issue is finally resolved, meaning smoother gameplay and happier shoppers.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
We’ve been listening to your feedback and packed this patch with fixes, improvements, and exciting new features:
🛒 Customer Fixes – No more freezing or endless waiting at self-checkouts and racks.
🏷️ Content Corrections – Adjusted product names and images for accuracy.
📦 Storage Rack Fix – Boxes no longer disappear when racks touch trash bins.
🚪 Front Door Update – Adjusted player collision with the front door.
❄️ Lighting Tweaks – Reduced glow from freezers and fridges.
🧱 New Modular Walls – Build your dream store layout with doors and windows.
⚖️ Placement Options – Choose between Realistic or Perfectly Aligned product placement.
👷 Stocker Upgrade - The trash bins at the back of the store can now be used by stockers.
👷 Stocker Upgrade 2 – Maximum stockers increased from 9 → 12.
⚡ Performance Improvements – Smoother gameplay across the board.
